purpose: Freeze the 0.4 end-to-end application workloads before profile-guided optimization.

reference.confirmation_architecture: A materially different supported wheel architecture

measurement.worker_processes: A fresh process for each backend and workload
measurement.timing: Median wall-clock nanoseconds per equivalent eager public Python workflow call
measurement.confidence_interval: Percentile 95% bootstrap interval of the Raptors/NumPy median ratio from independent resampling of each backend's timed samples
measurement.correctness: Compare every output's shape, dtype, and complete values against NumPy before timing
measurement.memory: Record tracemalloc peak and process peak RSS delta; disclose that RSS is allocator-dependent and tracemalloc omits native buffers

application_workflows.name: grouped_count_and_histogram
application_workflows.output: Group counts plus histogram counts and edges

release_threshold.common_operation_regression_guardrail: No cell may regress by more than 10% against the checked-in pre-optimization Raptors baseline without a reviewed, accepted explanation

baseline.meaning: Pre-optimization evidence only. None of the workflows currently meets the 0.8 median-ratio threshold; release qualification still requires profile-guided improvement, common-operation guardrails, and confirmation on a materially different supported architecture.
